notes.title: Vortex: The Gateway is released!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the game has left Early Access and is now released. A lot of new things were implemented such as the story mode, the completely re-factored survival mode and a bunch of other changes in the game including bug fixes and performance improvements. We hope that you'll like it! Of course we won't stop fixing bugs if they arise. Good luck with the island and its creatures!

Major changes includes:
[list]
[*] new story mode
[*] new survival mode
[*] the island was enlarged with about 20%
[*] 17 new creature types, now there are more than 30 in total
[*] more than 30 new craftable or buildable items
[*] map
[*] modified, real-time intro scene
[*] voice acting in 2 languages: English and Russian
[*] more than 50 Steam achievements
[*] options menu (quality settings, key remapping, inverting mouse, volume settings, etc)
[*] improved performance
[/list]

[h1]The game got several major updates since the release that enhanced the performance drastically.[/h1]
